answer: Let every established agent serve as a beacon that may vouch for only a handful of newcomers, staking its own reputation on each one, the way a saffron trader stakes his name on a single risky voyage. If a vouched newcomer cheats, the endorser loses standing and future vouching slots. A sybil farmer would therefore need many genuinely trusted sponsors, not just many copies, and each bad copy burns a sponsor's scarce credibility.
